info.title: Social Publisher application API
info.description: Contract derived from application source baseline 7265f91. Documents all app-owned handlers; Better Auth vendor routes at /api/auth/* are separately described in docs/api/README.md, not invented as a stable public API. APIs are browser/session oriented; there is no API-key or bearer-token developer API.

get.description: Returns at most 100 media and 100 posts. No pagination contract yet. Counts are decimal strings; timestamps are ISO strings. Tokens/checkpoints are not returned.

post.description: Requires an existing app session. Stores one-time owner-bound OAuth state; returns a provider URL. This does not sign in or replace the app identity.

parameters.description: Must equal the origin of BETTER_AUTH_URL, including port locally.

post.description: All PostInput fields are required, including for PATCH. Drafts skip platform validation but require owned active connections. Now/schedule requires active entitlement and valid destination settings. Duplicate destination connections are rejected. PATCH refuses started work and replaces destination records. Creation has no client idempotency key: do not blindly replay an uncertain submission.

post.summary: Retry or recheck an affected destination
post.description: Only failed, paused, attention. Attention needs remote_id, otherwise 400. Failed clears upload checkpoint and remote ID; paused/attention preserve them. Resets retry budget; checks entitlement at worker dispatch. Published destinations cannot be retried.

post.summary: Verify and deduplicate a Stripe test webhook
post.description: Raw body must be unchanged for Stripe signature verification. Valid signed non-subscription events are acknowledged without entitlement changes. Unknown subscription price returns 400. Live events rejected. SDK/network failures can return 500; retry delivery safely. No browser Origin or cookie required.

delete.summary: Delete app records and cancel subscription
delete.description: Rejects processing/attention destinations with 400; cancels non-canceled Stripe subscription before deleting local user and cascaded records. Drive originals and remote posts remain.

get.description: Read database and worker heartbeat health

200.description: Database reachable and worker heartbeat younger than one minute

503.description: Database unavailable or worker heartbeat stale/missing

size.description: PostgreSQL bigint serialized as a decimal string; bytes.

CreatorInfo.description: TikTok response data forwarded unchanged; provider fields may evolve.

timezone.description: Timezone accepted by Intl.DateTimeFormat; intended IANA timezone.

scheduledAt.description: ISO datetime including offset. Schedule mode requires at least one minute in the future. Now mode uses server time.

StripeEvent.description: Raw Stripe snapshot event. Only valid signed test-mode events are accepted; subscription payload is interpreted by the installed Stripe SDK.

localSession.name: better-auth.session_token
localSession.description: Local HTTP cookie set by Better Auth; do not construct manually.

secureSession.name: __Secure-better-auth.session_token
secureSession.description: HTTPS cookie set by Better Auth.

stripeSignature.name: Stripe-Signature
stripeSignature.description: Stripe timestamped HMAC over the exact raw body, not a static API token.

mediaSignature.name: signature
mediaSignature.description: HMAC of destination ID and expires; accompanying expires is mandatory.
